name: Canada Protection Plan (CPP)
ownership: Brand and wholly owned subsidiary (Canada Protection Plan Inc., insurance broker and administrator) of The Independent Order of Foresters since Oct 1, 2020; policies underwritten by Foresters Life Insurance Company or IOF
regulator: Not a licensed insurer; its policies are underwritten by Foresters Life Insurance Company / IOF (OSFI). CPP Inc. is a licensed insurance agency/administrator

metrics.note: Not applicable: CPP is a distributor/administrator, not a risk carrier. See foresters_life.json (FLIC total assets C$1.79bn; IOF C$19.6bn)

pm_structure.summary: CPP holds no general account. All invested assets backing CPP policies sit on FLIC/IOF balance sheets and are managed under Foresters' fully outsourced external-manager model. Refer to foresters_life.json for every investment, leverage and risk item.

AM Best: most Canadian distribution for FLIC/IOF Canada branch runs through the Canada Protection Plan program, with a shift toward whole life
